Meeting a leader opens an audience (a leader screen). Every leader follows an agenda drawn from their personality (Iron Fist, Manifest Destiny, Enlightened, Patron of the Arts, True Devotion, Peace and Plenty) and judges you by it every 10 turns; the screen lists what they like and dislike about you. Ways to improve relations: delegations (30 Gold), gifts (100 Gold), luxury trades, peace. A Declaration of Friendship (30 turns) forbids war between you; after 8 turns of friendship a high opinion allows an Alliance (40 turns): open borders, shared map knowledge and each side joins the war if the other is attacked. World Wonders can be built once in the whole world, only in Cities, and often need a specific site (coast, river, desert, hills). National Wonders can be built once per empire and usually require several copies of a building across your settlements. Natural Wonders are placed by the map: working or neighbouring them yields strong bonuses and discovering one grants Knowledge and Heritage (double for the first empire to find it).
World wonder: only one can exist in the whole world.

Your capital is a City. Every other settlement you found is a Town. Towns have no production queue: their production is converted to Gold and you purchase buildings and units in them. Towns grow on their own and, from 5 population, can be specialized (Farming, Mining, Trade Outpost, Fort, Urban Center). A specialized Town stops growing and sends its surplus food to your nearest City. Pay Gold to upgrade a Town into a City with a real production queue; the price rises with each City you own.
